name: Listen for dictation
description: Opens a live dictation on the local speech engine, for an app showing the words while someone is still speaking, and returns its id for speech:hear. Only its caller may feed it; one left unfed for two minutes is dropped. Needs the local engine, prepared (speech:prepare); other engines transcribe whole recordings only.

sampleRate.description: Sample rate of the raw PCM that speech:hear will be given.
